title: Build AI Agents from Scratch: Python, LangGraph, CrewAI, MCP & OpenAI APIs
description: A concise, step‑by‑step guide that teaches viewers how to construct sophisticated AI agents using only Python and a suite of modern tools—LangGraph for graph‑based reasoning, CrewAI for orchestrating agent teams, MCP for multi‑modal processing, and the OpenAI API for language understanding. Each scene delivers clear explanations, code snippets, and visual cues to ensure learners can replicate the process on their own.
